claim: Enabling an evolutionary loop in a multi-agent scientific discovery system introduces stronger exploration dynamics, leading to topic improvements and increased diversity.
falsifier: In a multi-agent scientific discovery system, compare exploration metrics (e.g., standard deviation of scores) and topic improvement with and without the evolutionary loop enabled.

exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported system, task, population, and conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Enabling an evolutionary loop–stronger exploration dynamics mechanism
